title: Beyond the principle-practice gap: Responsible AI as situated epistemic and ethical practice
abstract: arXiv:2611.06709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Responsible AI scholarship has found that ethical principles are frequently not reflected in AI design and development. Conceptualised as a `gap' between principle and practice, this is framed as a problem of implementation, awareness or compliance, and by implication, a deficit of systems or individual behaviour. This paper sets out an alternative explanation. Drawing on fourteen semi-structured interviews with actors designing and governing AI-enabled anti-trafficking systems across law enforcement, commercial, research, and survivor-support contexts, it argues that such apparent gaps emerge from the varied and complex institutional and professional conditions through which actors come to recognise some issues, but not others, as ethical problems requiring action. translated_title: 超越原则与实践的差距：作为情境化认识论与伦理实践的负责任人工智能
translated_abstract: 负责任人工智能（Responsible AI）研究发现，伦理原则经常无法体现在人工智能的设计与开发过程中。这一现象被概念化为“原则与实践之间的差距”，并被界定为执行、意识或合规层面的问题，其言下之意是系统或个体行为的缺陷。本文提出了一种替代性解释。通过对设计和治理人工智能赋能的反人口贩卖系统的相关参与者——涵盖执法、商业、研究和幸存者支持等不同场景——进行的十四次半结构化访谈，本文论证了这种表面上的差距实际上源于多样而复杂的制度性与专业性条件，正是在这些条件下，参与者才将某些问题（而非其他问题）识别为需要采取行动的伦理问题。研究表明，认识论选择与伦理判断相互交织，并追溯了四个相互关联的环节——感知、判断、情境化行动与社会技术……
tldr: 本文基于对反人口贩卖AI系统从业者的访谈，论证“原则与实践差距”并非执行缺陷，而是源于不同制度条件下人们对伦理问题认知方式的差异，主张将负责任AI理解为一种情境化的认识论与伦理实践。
en_tdlr: Drawing on interviews with actors designing AI anti-trafficking systems, this paper argues that the "principle-practice gap" arises not from implementation deficits but from varied institutional conditions shaping which issues are recognised as ethical problems, reframing Responsible AI as situated epistemic and ethical practice.
